evidence_policy: Runtime baselines and capability requirements are selected intent. All checked-in artifact evidence is pending. A compiled implementation descriptor is not per-target execution proof. External build, inspection and runtime records must match the exact target, source commit, artifact SHA-256, size and selected baseline; minimum-runtime verification is separate from a newer-runner test. No release or download is implied.
